description: Mars has no GPS and no global magnetosphere—a dust storm blinds an astronaut in seconds. We are ARIADNA (Autonomous Reckoning & Inertial Astronaut Direction Network Architecture) strike team, focused on disciplinary hardware, biomedical, architecture, and building an EVA survival navigation system. We combine a custom RTOS wrist HUD running magnetometer-free 6-DoF inertial dead reckoning with Free-Space Optical (FSO) laser beacons that obliterate positional drift to 0.0m.

details:
Project A.R.I.A.D.N.A is an autonomous emergency GNC (Guidance, Navigation, and Control) wearable system engineered to guarantee astronaut survival during surface EVAs in hostile Martian environments.

How it works & Benefits: During global Martian dust storms (𝝉 = 3), satellite links and GPS fail entirely. A.R.I.A.D.N.A solves this via a dual-core wearable architecture:

  1. 6-DoF Inertial Dead Reckoning: Tracks steps and heading offline without magnetometers, optimized with a 30x demonstration scale (6 steps per corridor leg).
  2. Short-Range Surface Laser Beacons (FSO): Surface laser emitters transmit real-time coordinates. An optical receiver module on the wrist (BPW34 photodiode + LM393 comparator) validates the light pulse against ESP-NOW RF packets within a 100 ms window, instantly collapsing accumulated inertial drift down to a ±0.45m residual floor upon impact.
  3. Blind Haptic Sonar HUD: Translates angular error into intuitive wrist vibrations (1 Hz on-course, 3 Hz adjusting, 5 Hz off-course) to bypass cognitive map-reading under extreme panic and prefrontal cortex suppression.

Tools, Coding Languages, Hardware, & Software:

  • Hardware: LilyGo T-Watch Ultra (ESP32-S3), T-Display-S3 (Laser TX), BPW34 photodiodes, DRV2605L haptic driver, Bosch BMI270 6-DoF IMU.
  • Software & Toolchain: PlatformIO, Arduino IDE, FreeRTOS, LVGL (Light and Versatile Graphics Library), C/C++, QOI-565 offline map compression engine, ESP-NOW protocol.

Creativity & Considerations: Inspired by Apollo life-support safety limits and modern space analogs (HI-SEAS), A.R.I.A.D.N.A mitigates fatal physiological risks—such as hypercapnia (CO2 buildup) and heat storage thresholds—by shifting navigation from complex visual processing to instinctive tactile motor actions.

SI Acknowledgment: Generative AI tools (LLMs) were utilized for C++ embedded debugging, literature synthesis, and English translation.
